Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Jack Webb is credited on 333 distinct recordings across 7 programs from 1946-10-13 through 1955-09-20. Documented roles include performer on 332 recordings, producer on 2 recordings, and narrator on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Dragnet (performer on 274 recordings and producer on 2 recordings; 274 distinct recordings), Pat Novak, for Hire (performer on 22 recordings; 22 distinct recordings), Jeff Regan, Investigator (performer on 20 recordings; 20 distinct recordings), Escape (performer on 8 recordings and narrator on 1 recording; 9 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), Dr. Kildare (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), and Mr. Malone (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Joe Friday (278 portrayals), Pat Novak (22 portrayals), and Jeff Regan (20 portrayals).
